Definition: Gereshom, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Gershom is a person named 14 times in Scripture, in Exodus, Judges, and 1 Chronicles. The full story lives on the Gershom profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God keeps Gershom in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
